* **Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy:** we want work to be something you look forward to.
* **Quality results in quantity:** we care about excellence and attention to detail.
* **TEAM, Together everyone achieves more:** collaboration is how we get our best results.

Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

#### **About the role**

In this role, you’ll build a profitable and sustainable products business alongside our domains portfolio. Your scope will include SSL certificates, Email and Plesk as commercial product lines, as well as the RCP (reseller control panel) journeys that enable our resellers to purchase, provision, manage and renew these products.

You’ll be accountable for their financial performance and quality, while managing supplier partnerships to keep our offering competitive and future-proof. The role reports to the Director of Product.

#### **Key responsibilities**

* Own the SSL, Email and Plesk portfolio and P&L: positioning, assortment, pricing proposals (with Pricing and Finance), margin and lifecycle decisions from launch to sunset.
* Own supplier partnerships with Certificate Authorities, our email platform provider and Plesk/WebPros: contracts, volume tiers, rebates, SLAs, roadmap alignment and escalations.
* Grow adoption across our reseller base through cross-sell with domains and hosting, bundles, purchase journey placement and launches with Sales and Marketing.
* Run product initiatives as structured projects, including supplier integrations, API changes and compliance changes such as CA/B Forum rules.
* Shape the product roadmap with a commercial lens and partner with Engineering on delivery.
* Track results against clear targets: margin and revenue per product line, attach and renewal rates, and on-time delivery of milestones and roadmap items.

#### **What we are looking for**

**Competences**

* **Hosting & Security Products Knowledge:** Solid understanding of SSL/TLS certificates (DV/OV/EV, validation, CA/B Forum requirements and lifecycle changes), email hosting and anti-spam, and Plesk licensing and hosting control panels.
* **Supplier & Vendor Management:** Negotiates commercial terms, volume tiers, rebates and SLAs; runs business reviews; manages supplier performance, dependency and contract risk.
* **Commercial & P&L Acumen:** Builds business cases; understands pricing, margin, unit economics, cannibalisation and reseller incentive models.
* **Product Strategy & Roadmapping:** Translates strategy into operational roadmaps for the RCP and the SSL, email and Plesk product lines.
* **Project & Programme Management:** Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.
* **Data & Funnel Analytics:** Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.
* **AI Proficiency:** Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.

**How we work at Openprovider**

* **Self-management:** you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.
* **Learning Agility and AI Literacy:** you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.
* **Adaptive Innovation Mindset:** you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.
* **Quality Orientation:** you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.
* **Customer Focus:** you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

#### **What we offer**

* 100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);
* Paid time off and sick leave;
* International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;
* Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;
* Quarterly review and annual salary review;
* Flexible working hours;
* We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;
* Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;
* Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;
* A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.  
  
We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.  
  
That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.  
  
We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 90+ employees, who are spread across 20+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.

Working closely with Engineering, AI/ML, Design, and Data teams, you will take capabilities from discovery and prototyping through production deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.

description:
#### **About the company**

Openprovider is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology company founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, Netherlands.  
  
We are a fully-remote organization with more than 90 team members spread across 20+ countries.  
  
A diverse and inclusive organization, we support a healthy work/life balance and are constantly looking for new ways to help the well-being of our people. We support a flexible schedule and are 100% performance and result-oriented.  
  
At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.  
  
Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?  
  
Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve. Our world is changing fast, especially with AI, and we see that as an opportunity to stay ahead of change, shape it and create more value for our customers.  
  
**Our values**

* **Be a wolf, not a sheep:** we value the entrepreneurial spirit in everyone.
* **Knowledge equals power:** we are constantly hungry to learn, for ourselves and our customers.
* **Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy:** we want work to be something you look forward to.
* **Quality results in quantity:** we care about excellence and attention to detail.
* **TEAM, Together everyone achieves more:** collaboration is how we get our best results.

Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

#### **About the role**

In this role, you’ll build a profitable and sustainable products business alongside our domains portfolio. Your scope will include SSL certificates, Email and Plesk as commercial product lines, as well as the RCP (reseller control panel) journeys that enable our resellers to purchase, provision, manage and renew these products.

You’ll be accountable for their financial performance and quality, while managing supplier partnerships to keep our offering competitive and future-proof. The role reports to the Director of Product.

#### **Key responsibilities**

* Own the SSL, Email and Plesk portfolio and P&L: positioning, assortment, pricing proposals (with Pricing and Finance), margin and lifecycle decisions from launch to sunset.
* Own supplier partnerships with Certificate Authorities, our email platform provider and Plesk/WebPros: contracts, volume tiers, rebates, SLAs, roadmap alignment and escalations.
* Grow adoption across our reseller base through cross-sell with domains and hosting, bundles, purchase journey placement and launches with Sales and Marketing.
* Run product initiatives as structured projects, including supplier integrations, API changes and compliance changes such as CA/B Forum rules.
* Shape the product roadmap with a commercial lens and partner with Engineering on delivery.
* Track results against clear targets: margin and revenue per product line, attach and renewal rates, and on-time delivery of milestones and roadmap items.

#### **What we are looking for**

**Competences**

* **Hosting & Security Products Knowledge:** Solid understanding of SSL/TLS certificates (DV/OV/EV, validation, CA/B Forum requirements and lifecycle changes), email hosting and anti-spam, and Plesk licensing and hosting control panels.
* **Supplier & Vendor Management:** Negotiates commercial terms, volume tiers, rebates and SLAs; runs business reviews; manages supplier performance, dependency and contract risk.
* **Commercial & P&L Acumen:** Builds business cases; understands pricing, margin, unit economics, cannibalisation and reseller incentive models.
* **Product Strategy & Roadmapping:** Translates strategy into operational roadmaps for the RCP and the SSL, email and Plesk product lines.
* **Project & Programme Management:** Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.
* **Data & Funnel Analytics:** Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.
* **AI Proficiency:** Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.

**How we work at Openprovider**

* **Self-management:** you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.
* **Learning Agility and AI Literacy:** you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.
* **Adaptive Innovation Mindset:** you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.
* **Quality Orientation:** you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.
* **Customer Focus:** you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

#### **What we offer**

* 100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);
* Paid time off and sick leave;
* International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;
* Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;
* Quarterly review and annual salary review;
* Flexible working hours;
* We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;
* Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;
* Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;
* A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

#### **About us**

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.  
  
We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.  
  
That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.  
  
We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 90+ employees, who are spread across 20+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.

Working with product management and market-facing stakeholders, the Senior Product Owner translates roadmap initiatives and projects into actionable development work, produces and maintains product artifacts, and drives delivery — while market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set jointly with in-market leadership.

On the coordination side, this role supports and oversees the product-owner process for the India-based team: scheduling and facilitating agile ceremonies, acting as a quality gate on product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts, and building a strong product-owner community of practice. The ideal candidate understands manufacturing operations, ERP systems, and agile product development, and is comfortable working across technical teams, product owners, and in-market product leadership.

**Agile Development Collaboration**

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work with in-market product leadership (product management and market-facing stakeholders) to align execution with roadmap and customer needs.

* Provide product expertise for internal stakeholders and help drive continuous improvement of product capabilities.

**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

title: Senior Product Manager II
description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Every day, Gracenote ingests data for over 100,000 channels and hundreds of streaming catalogs worldwide. It arrives through thousands of partner feeds covering linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and program metadata, in every format imaginable and changing constantly. That data powers entertainment discovery for the world's top cable, OTT, CE and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager II to own the Single Ingest Platform, the system that gets all of this data into Gracenote. Based in our Bengaluru engineering center, you will report to our Director of Product Management, Data Ingest and Delivery, and work alongside our Data Delivery Product Manager. Together you own how data enters and leaves our AI-driven metadata factory.

This is a software platform role, and the platform is a service. Teams downstream decide what to do with the data once it lands. Your job is to make sure every source is set up fast, every field we need is captured correctly, and every change reaches the platform in minutes. Speed and accuracy at scale are the whole game.

It is also a hands-on role. You will write specs yourself, work directly with engineers and Data Architects, and query the data to answer your own questions. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work, and who sees AI as the way to run thousands of feeds without thousands of manual fixes.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision, roadmap and delivery for the Single Ingest Platform across linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and every other source type our datasets depend on.
* Own the speed and accuracy of getting partner data into Gracenote, from onboarding new sources to processing every update.
* Drive AI innovation so ingest scales to new sources, markets and metadata types with greater speed and efficiency, without adding manual processes.
* Ensure the platform is monitored for performance and breaks, so issues are caught and resolved before they affect downstream teams.
* Run ingest as a service, translating the needs of Dataset Product Managers, metadata factory teams and Delivery into a prioritized roadmap.
* Define and publish the platform's service levels and key metrics for speed, accuracy, reliability and cost, and use them to drive decisions.
* Work effectively across a globally distributed organization, with strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US and EU stakeholders.

 **Qualifications**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on platform, data or data integration products.
* Hands-on experience with data ingestion or integration at scale: onboarding external sources, handling format and schema changes, and monitoring data flows.
* Has applied AI or ML inside a product, not only for personal productivity. Examples include extraction, classification, anomaly detection or schema mapping. Can reason about confidence, error rates and when a human needs to step in.
* Actively uses LLMs in day-to-day product work to speed up analysis, automate repetitive PM tasks and make better decisions. Be prepared to walk through concrete examples in the interview.
* Demonstrated appetite for hands-on IC work at a senior level. Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL and REST APIs, and able to write or LLM-assist your own Python or SQL scripts to answer product questions.
* Runs a product on a small set of input and output metrics, and delivers predictably against commitments in a structured, milestone-driven development process.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proven ability to influence stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience with TV and entertainment metadata, EPG data or content supply chains.
* Familiarity with industry metadata and feed standards such as CableLabs ADI, TV-Anytime, or MovieLabs MEC and Avails.
* Experience with near-real-time or event-driven data pipelines.
* Experience building partner-facing source specifications or self-service onboarding tools.
* Experience partnering with Data Architects to shape complex business data into coherent, extensible, scalable structures.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.
